title: Design tests that expose boundary bugs
instructions: Write a JUnit 5 test suite for Clamp.clamp(value, min, max). It returns min below the interval, max above it, otherwise value; min > max throws IllegalArgumentException.

The implementation is provided. Test its public contract rather than reproducing its branch structure. Include a degenerate interval and an exception assertion. Explain which plausible bug each test would catch.
JUnit source is an illustrative reference: JUnit is not installed or run in this browser. The development check uses a separate plain-Java requirement harness.
Notedra authored practice. The time class is a suggested practice budget, not an official assessment duration.
Write and review your own attempt before revealing the reference. Code on this page is ephemeral and is not compiled, run or automatically graded. Multiple correct implementations are valid.

requirements.text: Select below, lower-bound, inside, upper-bound, above and degenerate-interval inputs with explicit expected values.
Use an exception assertion for a reversed interval and avoid swallowing a missing exception.
Keep the pure clamp function testable without console input; explain why executing every line does not establish a strong test suite.
